name: Told a fact, Boop keeps it where it belongs; praise it doesn't
why: HARNESS.md §5 and steering.md (Remembering, Writing): a project or session fact is a note for today, a lasting fact about the person goes to About you and how they like things to Preferences, in a few plain words; a fact naming someone else is today's, since long-term keeps no other people's names, but Boop's own name (Pip, in the sample memory) isn't someone else's; praise isn't remembered. A line that's already there is ActionTests' (Jev may skip it or the store refuses it)

input.words: remember the demo is on Thursday

expect: you said → react(feeling: happy|curious|excited, word: okay|yes|done|good|yay|none), remember(text: "*demo*Thursday*", where: today)

input.words: remember I always review PRs before lunch

expect: you said → react(feeling: happy|curious|excited, word: okay|yes|done|good|yay|review|none), remember(text: "*PRs*lunch*", where: about_you)

input.words: remember I'd rather see tests before docs

expect: you said → react(feeling: happy|curious|excited, word: okay|yes|done|good|yay|none), remember(text: "*tests*docs*", where: preference)

input.words: remember I work with Bob on landing

expect: you said → react(feeling: happy|curious|excited, word: okay|yes|done|good|yay|none), remember(text: "*Bob*landing*", where: today)

input.words: Hey Pip, remember I always pair on Mondays

expect: you said → react(feeling: happy|curious|excited, word: okay|yes|done|good|yay|hi|none), remember(text: "*pair*Monday*", where: about_you)
you said → react(feeling: proud|happy|excited, word: thanks|love|yay|good|hooray|nice|none)
